Messages.Author: Rob LeGood
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I don't have access to my cards at the moment but I need a quick
clarification..

Is Legacy of Power a Dominate card? I was looking on the Wizards card
list site, but it had it a a striaght Action Modifier, but with a
superior ability.

Could someone, please post the correct version of the card?

Many small woodland animals give you thanks,

Rob.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:

Ignore the "(S)" in WotC's card list text - the card isn't printed
that way. All the card text is part of the single effect:

Legacy of Power Reaction 3 blood
Requires a ready Prince, Justicar or Inner Circle member.
Only usable when a vampire you control enters combat. A second vampire
you control may play this card to end combat. Tap the second vampire.
Combat ends. Both vampires engaged in combat go to torpor.

(This correct card text is lifted from Shane Travis' list)
